title: Hire activation mini-canvas: 10-day buddy handoff
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, practice-focused playbook for ramping a lateral IC or early-mid level hire to first independent customer-impact tasks within 10 calendar days. It combines a hiring-acceptance checklist, interview-pass signals, and a tightly scoped buddy handoff so hiring managers and buddies can run a fast, measurable activation.

Scope and use cases:
- Lateral ICs (IC2–IC3) across engineering and product-facing roles.
- When speed-to-impact matters (small teams, feature-squads, emergency backfills).
- Not for senior leadership, managers, or highly restricted security roles (those use full 30–90d plan).

Quick timeline (10 days):
- Day 0 (offer accepted): welcome packet sent, credentials request, SW access gating checklist opened by hiring manager.
- Day 1: orient (company values, team goals), buddy intro, first tiny task assigned (readable and verifiable).
- Days 2–4: shadow pairing on 1–2 recurring tasks, daily 30-min sync with buddy.
- Days 5–7: independent execution on scoped customer-impact task with buddy review loop.
- Days 8–10: polish + demo to team, success signal review, handoff to long-form onboarding owner.

Roles & owners:
- Hiring manager: approves first-customer-impact task, verifies access, owns success signal.
- Buddy: daily pairing, micro-code reviews, 1:1 on Day 5 and Day 10.
- People Ops: sends welcome packet, schedules intro meetings, updates HR checklist.
- IT/Security: verifies least-privilege access before Day 1.

Acceptance checklist (pre-Day 1):
- Offer acceptance logged in ATS (owner: recruiter).
- IT ticket open for accounts and VPN (owner: hiring manager).
- Workspace + Slack channels created, relevant docs linked in onboarding doc (owner: People Ops).
- First-customer-impact task created in Jira with clear definition of done (owner: hiring manager).

Interview pass signals (for fast hires):
Scoring rubric (0–3 for each):
- Problem decomposition (0–3): asks clarifying Qs, breaks problem into discrete steps.
- Practical coding/implementation (0–3): writes correct, readable snippet or clear pseudocode for the task.
- Debugging/thinking aloud (0–3): explains approach to failure modes and testing.
- Collaboration cues (0–3): asks about team constraints, docs, asks follow-ups.
Pass threshold: total >= 9 and no single category = 0.
Notes: rubric emphasizes practical ability to complete the small task quickly rather than academic answers.

Example first-customer-impact tasks (pick 1):
- Fix flaky backend cron that prevents data export; add retry and unit test; deploy to staging.
- Add pagination to an internal team dashboard and correct sorting bug.
- Improve an embeddings batcher to skip null rows and log counters.
Each task: must be scoped <= 8 hours for an IC with full access.

Buddy handoff protocol:
- Pre-Day 1: buddy reads candidate PRs, recent incident notes.
- Day 1: 60-min intro + walkthrough of the task board, repo layout, CI signal.
- Daily (Days 2–7): 30-min pairing or async check-ins; record blockers in ticket.
- Day 5: formal micro-review: buddy runs code review checklist and records one actionable feedback item.
- Day10: demo + retrospective (15–30 mins) with hiring manager; capture learnings in the onboarding doc.

Success signals (must meet 2 of 3):
- Ticket closed with green CI and acceptance criteria met.
- Candidate demonstrates independent triage of a minor runtime error during task.
- Buddy and hiring manager report readiness to continue to 30d plan.

Failure mitigation and recovery:
- If signals not met by Day 10: extend to 21 days with a focused correction plan (owner: hiring manager + People Ops).
- If critical access or security blockers exist, pause timeline until resolved; document risk and expected lift time.

Communication templates (short):
- Day 1 DM to candidate: welcome + 2 attachments (task ticket link, onboarding doc link).
- Day 5 DM: mid-sprint check-in template (3 bullets: blockers, recent wins, questions).
- Day 10 DM: demo invite + short feedback form link.

Metrics to capture (for program health):
- % hires achieving first-customer-impact by Day 10.
- Median time to first merged PR for microboarding hires.
- Buddy satisfaction (1–5) after Day 10.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we want an official low-risk task library per team? (R: product/eng leads)
- Can IT standardize the Day 0 access SLA to <= 48 hours? (R: security & IT)
- Should this run as opt-in for candidates with fewer than X months remote experience?

Related artifacts and templates: see linked_artifacts above for the hiring-template PR and the Confluence anchor.

Quick links (placeholders):
- Onboarding doc root: https://confluence.redwood.ai/HR/onboarding-root
- ATS record: https://ats.example/record/####
- 10-day checklist board: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PEOPLE-913

Notes: keep this doc short, iterate after 10 hires. Use the rubric as a practical gate, not as veto-only.

-- Aisha (People Ops)
